Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Missouri legislature upholds state's sexual misconduct laws declaring same sex relations immoral 2. Canada, radio talk show host faces disciplinary action for on-air anti-gay comments 3. Interview with Joanne Mantell, the director of GMHC's study to reduce high-risk sex practices in the gay community COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation featuring Jose Sarria 4. New Zealand, Parliament votes to decriminalize homosexual sex 5. Chicago, National Organization of Gay and Lesbian Scientists and Technical Professionals produce brochure on the contributions to society of homosexual scientists 5. Andy Humm discusses European openness towards AIDS education on the television COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 6. Warning about the unknown effects of spermicidal lube on rectal tissues during anal intercourse 7. The US Office of Civil Rights unwilling to respond to reports of discrimination against persons with AIDS COMMERCIAL: Phil Reed for New York State Senate 8. Sports Report including an interview with Cliff Goulet on Gay Games '86 and clips from the Closing Ceremony COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 9. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Vin Longo of GMHC's Intake Department for new patients 10. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This week in gay history with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Woman Talk" theater piece 2. Interview with director Derek Jarman on his film "Caravaggio" and the artist's life, with clips, tape cuts off
